description: This Java class 'FinalPrice' models price information for products, including discounts, original and final prices, and related metadata for display purposes in a catalog.

classes.name: FinalPrice
classes.description: A transient data model used to encapsulate price-related information for products, including discount status, prices, and additional offers.

methods.name: getAdditionalPrices
methods.description: Returns a list of additional FinalPrice instances associated with this price, possibly representing alternative or supplementary prices.

methods.name: setAdditionalPrices
methods.description: Sets the list of additional FinalPrice instances.

methods.name: getOriginalPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the original listed price of the product.

methods.name: getDiscountPercent
methods.description: Returns the percentage discount applied to the price.

methods.name: getDiscountEndDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date when the discount expires.

methods.name: isDiscounted
methods.description: Returns true if the price is discounted.

methods.name: setDiscounted
methods.description: Marks this price as discounted or not.

methods.name: setFinalPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price which may reflect discounts or other adjustments.

methods.name: setDefaultPrice
methods.description: Marks whether this price is the default.

methods.name: isDefaultPrice
methods.description: Indicates if this is the default price.

methods.name: setProductPrice
methods.description: Associates a ProductPrice object with this FinalPrice instance.
